previewText: Transfer history form attached and money sent

fields.heading: ISA transfer from {company_name}
fields.body:
Good {morning_or_afternoon},

Thank you for your submitted ISA transfer authority form on behalf of our mutual client to request the transfer of ISA funds from {company_name} to {provider_name}.

The money will be transferred to you by bank transfer and should be received by you within 1-2 working days, and includes your specified transfer reference.

Please find attached the associated transfer history form, password protected with the client's NINO (all capitals, no spaces).

Please do not hesitate to contact us should any further details be required prior to completion of the transfer on 020 3475 8666.
